entry_logic: Fast EMA (span=fast_ema) crosses above Slow EMA (span=slow_ema) on bar close. Crossover = fast_ema_prev <= slow_ema_prev AND fast_ema_current > slow_ema_current. Enter at close of the crossover bar.
exit_logic_t2: Simple: (1) low <= initial_stop → exit at stop. (2) fast_ema_current < slow_ema_current on close → exit at close. No chandelier in T2.
exit_logic_t3b_onward: Combined: (1) low <= stop [initial or chandelier, from START of candle] → exit at stop. (2) IF chandelier NOT yet active: fast_ema < slow_ema on close → exit at close. (3) AFTER all exit checks pass: if mfe >= chandelier_activate_r, update chandelier stop = highest_high - chandelier_atr_mult * atr.
chandelier_sequencing_rule: CRITICAL BUG TO AVOID: chandelier stop must be updated AFTER all exit checks, never before. The stop checked in step 1 must use the stop value from the START of the candle. Updating chandelier before the stop check causes premature exits on the activation candle itself.
ohlcv_load_instructions: Check ohlcv_cache_primary first (T15 1D data). If empty, check ohlcv_cache_fallback. If both empty, download from Binance ccxt. CSV format: columns=[timestamp,open,high,low,close,volume], timestamp in ms. File naming: BTC_USDT_1d.csv etc.
output_file_convention: Use exact filenames from the pipeline document specification. Do NOT prefix filenames with the method name. E.g. use 'phase_t2_summary.csv' not 'phase_t2_dualma_summary.csv'.
t1_selection_rationale: EMA30/EMA100 chosen over auto-recommended EMA10/200: 5-combo zone vs 3-combo corner zone, ema200_price filter matches Donchian pipeline (no circularity), lower drawdown -12.49R vs -17.59R. T1 gate: PASS, zone 100% (5/5), avg_r=+0.573R, PF=1.83, win%=24.1%.
win_rate_note: Win rate 24.1% is below the 30-45% healthy range. Entire grid shows 15-25% win rates — structural to this crypto universe. Same pattern as Donchian (24.6%). Fat-tail structure: large infrequent winners. Must verify in T4 block bootstrap that edge is not just 1-2 events.
